headline_stat.name: POST-sleep SWR significant replay fraction vs cell-ID-shuffle control
headline_stat.value: committed pipeline: 10.9% (344/3162) vs 6.1% control, p=1.9e-11; README prose (from notebook): 11.9% (277/2327) vs 6.0%, p=1.9e-12

stated_limitation: Two caveats. The conjunction of two shuffle tests at p < 0.025 each is not exactly a 5% test, which is why the cell-identity control rather than the nominal level is used as the chance line. And the direction template that maximises |r| is chosen per event before testing, which is what the Bonferroni correction across the two templates accounts for.

justification.dataset: 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki dorsal CA1, Achilles linear track, PRE/track/POST) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal place cells and replay.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3 via remfile; position recovery validated as exact-affine, correct sampling rates, REM exclusion, excitatory-only cell-type filtering, and explicit peak-rate/spike-count quality criteria.
justification.analysis: Zhang-1998 Bayesian decoding with weighted-correlation sequence scoring, column-cycle plus time-bin shuffles, Bonferroni across two templates, a cell-ID-shuffle empirical false-positive control, and a PRE/POST contrast that ties the effect to experience.
justification.correctness: The committed cache, replay_stats.npz, and figure 05 are mutually consistent (10.9%/3162), but the README's headline prose numbers (11.9%/2327/6.0%/p=1.9e-12/MW 7.6e-09) trace only to the un-re-run committed notebook and cannot be reproduced by the pipeline that generated the figures, an internal inconsistency across committed artifacts.
justification.figures: Figures are excellent and internally correct: ordered place fields, decoder validation, clean ripple-triggered average, posterior diagonals in example events ranked by effect strength, and honest population statistics with a proper empirical chance line and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: The conclusion (POST replay far above chance, PRE indistinguishable from control) is robustly supported by both committed analyses and limitations are explicitly and thoughtfully named, but the write-up cites notebook numbers while referencing figures showing slightly different values without acknowledging the mismatch.
justification.verdict: Core work is sound and the finding is real and well-controlled; it needs one specific fix, reconciling the README/notebook numbers with the committed pipeline figures and cache, before the reported statistics can be trusted verbatim.
